svg.title: Tech stack
svg.desc: A photo of a GTX 580 graphics card with my tech stack labelled on its parts. Systems: Linux, NixOS, bubblewrap, dinit, Docker. Apps: Svelte, Tone.js, Cloudflare, Tauri. Embedded: ESP32, FreeRTOS, PlatformIO, Raspberry Pi. Languages: C++, C, Rust, Python, TypeScript, Swift. Networks: ROS 2, CycloneDDS, BATMAN-adv, UDP.
